fields.CameraDataTable.LimitAngleHDistance_Max: Distance at which the max horizontal limit fully applies.
fields.CameraDataTable.LimitAngleHDistance_Min: Distance at which the min horizontal limit starts applying.
fields.CameraDataTable.LimitAngleV_Max: Max vertical camera angle (degrees). Caps how far the camera looks down.
fields.CameraDataTable.LimitAngleV_Min: Min vertical camera angle (degrees). Caps how far it looks up.
fields.CameraDataTable.OwnerHeightScale: Height factor for the camera owner focus (0.84 vanilla). Lower hugs the ground, higher frames jumpers.
fields.CameraDataTable.RotationPitch_AttenuateR: Damping on camera pitch. Higher = lazier vertical follow.
fields.CameraDataTable.RotationYaw_AttenuateRat: Damping on camera yaw. Higher = lazier horizontal follow.
fields.CameraDataTable.TargetCamera_Distance: Locked-on camera distance (units). The core readability knob.
fields.CameraDataTable.TargetCamera_ActionDista: Camera distance during action bursts (320 vanilla). Pulls back so dashes read clearly.
Seconds to ease to the action distance on dash.
Seconds to ease to the action distance on jump.
Seconds to ease to the action distance while running.
Seconds to ease to the action distance on sidestep.
fields.CameraDataTable.TargetCamera_DownDistanc: Camera distance while the target is knocked down (475 vanilla). Pulls out to show okizeme.
Seconds to ease to the knocked-down distance.
fields.CameraDataTable.TargetCamera_NormalDista: Seconds to ease back to normal distance after action/down states.
Delay (seconds) before returning to normal distance. 3 vanilla.
fields.CameraDataTable.TargetCamera_OffsetAngle: Vertical angle offset (degrees) for the locked camera. Slight tilt keeps feet and heads in frame.
fields.CollisionModifyDataTable.ID: Row ID, referenced from Damage rows (CP_010_ATTACKC = Yuji skill hit, ...).
fields.CollisionModifyDataTable.Life_Time: Seconds this modified volume stays live. 1 vanilla; raise for lingering zones.
fields.CollisionModifyDataTable.Location: Volume offset (X/Y/Z units) from the default hit position. Pushes the box forward/sideways/up.
fields.CollisionModifyDataTable.Location_Time: Seconds to blend to the offset position. 0 = snaps instantly.
fields.CollisionModifyDataTable.Location_WaitTi: Delay (seconds) before the offset starts applying.
fields.CollisionModifyDataTable.bLocation_Absol: True = the offset ignores facing and uses world axes. False follows the attacker facing (usual).
fields.CollisionModifyDataTable.Size: Box size (X/Y/Z units). The reach/disjoint knob: bigger boxes hit earlier and around guards.
fields.CollisionModifyDataTable.Size_Time: Seconds to grow to full size. Small values make the box pop out fast.
fields.CollisionModifyDataTable.Size_WaitTime: Delay (seconds) before the box starts growing.
fields.DecalDataTable.ID: Row ID (DCL_*). Referenced from ground-bounce decal slots.
fields.DecalDataTable.Filename: Decal blueprint asset stamped onto the ground (cracks, scorch).
fields.DecalDataTable.bResident: True = keep the decal resident in memory (frequent bounce marks). False streams it in on demand.
fields.DomainExpansionDataTable.ID: Row ID, one per domain owner (CP_020 = Megumi, ...). Linked from CharacterSpecialAttack rows.
fields.DomainExpansionDataTable.CastingTime: Cast/channel time (seconds) before the domain goes live. 4 vanilla; the punish window.
fields.DomainExpansionDataTable.Duration: How long the domain persists (seconds). 0 = instant/one-shot application.
fields.DomainExpansionDataTable.CursedEnergyDis: Seconds the user is barred from energy actions after casting. The all-in cost of a domain.
fields.DomainExpansionDataTable.HitTargetType: Who the domain wave can touch (EnemyOnly usually). None = pure zone with no direct hit.
fields.DomainExpansionDataTable.Id_BuffDebuff_E: Status applied to enemies caught inside. The sure-hit payload.
fields.DomainExpansionDataTable.Id_BuffDebuff_U: Status applied to the caster (self-buff while the domain runs).
fields.DomainExpansionDataTable.Id_DomainExpans: Stat-rate row for everyone inside the domain.
Stat-rate row for enemies inside (usually debuffs).
fields.DomainExpansionDataTable.Id_Map: Stage-map override while the domain runs. None = keep the current stage.
fields.DomainExpansionDataTable.SetActionType_A: Forced action state for allies inside. None = act freely.
fields.DomainExpansionDataTable.SetActionType_E: Forced action state for enemies inside (bind/paralyze for sure-hit feel).
fields.DomainExpansionDataTable.bAdjustGroundLo: True = snap the domain origin to the ground. Keeps it from floating on ledges.
fields.DomainExpansionDataTable.bFinishOtherDom: True = this domain shatters rival domains on clash win. The tiebreaker rule.
fields.DomainExpansionDataTable.bTargetCharacte: True = pin the target character for the domain sequence.
fields.DomainExpansionDataTable.bTeamMemberUniq: True = also bind the caster's teammates (full-party cinematic domains).
fields.DomainExpansionRateDataTable.ID: Row ID (CP_140 = base, _ALLY/_ENEMY = side-specific). Multipliers active inside the domain; 1 = unchanged.
fields.DomainExpansionRateDataTable.Damage_Rate: Damage multiplier inside the domain. 0.9 vanilla for Sukuna's shrine (chip control).
fields.DomainExpansionRateDataTable.DownTime_Mi: Extra minimum knockdown time (seconds) added inside the domain.
fields.DomainExpansionRateDataTable.DownTime_Ma: Extra maximum knockdown time (seconds) added inside the domain.
fields.DomainExpansionRateDataTable.Dash_Speed_: Short-dash speed multiplier inside the domain.
Medium-dash speed multiplier inside the domain.
Extended-dash speed multiplier inside the domain.
fields.DomainExpansionRateDataTable.Dash_GaugeC: Dash cost multiplier inside the domain. Below 1 = dashes are cheap inside.
Dash startup-cost multiplier inside the domain.
fields.DomainExpansionRateDataTable.Dash_Cancel: Dash cancel-window multiplier inside the domain. Below 1 = more committal footwork.
fields.DomainExpansionRateDataTable.DashAir_Spe: Short air-dash speed multiplier inside the domain.
Medium air-dash speed multiplier inside the domain.
Extended air-dash speed multiplier inside the domain.
fields.DomainExpansionRateDataTable.DashAir_Gau: Air-dash cost multiplier inside the domain.
Air-dash startup-cost multiplier inside the domain.
fields.DomainExpansionRateDataTable.HomingDashA: Short homing-dash speed multiplier inside the domain.
Medium homing-dash speed multiplier inside the domain.
Extended homing-dash speed multiplier inside the domain.
Homing-dash cost multiplier inside the domain.
Homing-dash startup-cost multiplier inside the domain.
fields.EffectColorCorrectDataTable.ID: Row ID (FX_*). Screen-grade overlay tied to an effect (domain tints, burns).
fields.EffectColorCorrectDataTable.bColorCorrec: Master switch: True = this grading actually applies.
fields.EffectColorCorrectDataTable.Radius: Radius (units) the grading covers. 50 = tight flash, 150+ = stage wash.
fields.EffectColorCorrectDataTable.Height: Vertical extent of the graded volume. 0 = flat disc.
fields.EffectColorCorrectDataTable.ContrastRate: Contrast multiplier (X/Y/Z/W). Below 1 flattens, above 1 punches.
fields.EffectColorCorrectDataTable.GainRate: Gain/brightness multiplier. Above 1 blows out toward white.
fields.EffectColorCorrectDataTable.SaturationRa: Saturation multiplier. 1 = normal; 0 drains to grey for bleak domains.
fields.EffectColorCorrectDataTable.FadeInTime: Seconds to fade the grade in. Snappy hits use ~0.1, domains ~1.
fields.EffectColorCorrectDataTable.FadeOutTime: Seconds to fade the grade out.
fields.EffectColorCorrectDataTable.CrossFadeTim: Crossfade (seconds) when handing off between grades.
fields.EffectColorCorrectDataTable.ForceCorrect: Seconds the grade is forced on regardless of range checks. 0 = respect checks.
fields.EffectColorCorrectDataTable.DelayCorrect: Delay (seconds) before the grade kicks in.
fields.EffectColorCorrectDataTable.PostProcessM: Post-process material asset. None = color math only, no custom material.
Seconds the post-process material stays active.
Blend weight of the post-process material. 0 = invisible.
fields.EffectColorCorrectDataTable.NiagaraParam: Niagara parameter driven by this grade. None = not tied to particles.

EGameAttackType.None: No attack class. Utility/system rows that should skip attack buckets.
EGameAttackType.BindingVows: System/binding-vow hit (scripted, e.g. unkillable-flagged). Unblockable by design.

EGameDamageType.None: No reaction. Hit registers with no victim animation (stealth/system).
EGameDamageType.Normal: Standard standing reaction. The default for jabs and pokes.
EGameDamageType.NormalAir: Airborne-standard reaction. Juggles instead of grounding.
EGameDamageType.Down: Knockdown. Victim hits the floor and must tech or rise.
EGameDamageType.Blow: Launch. Sends the victim flying for combo extensions.
EGameDamageType.BlowSmall: Short launch (pop-up). Keeps the victim close for pressure.
EGameDamageType.BlowSpin: Spinning launch. Long, stylish juggle arc.
EGameDamageType.CentipedeRestraintFall: Centipede restraint ending in a slam.
EGameDamageType.SimpleDomainCounterStun: Stun from a Simple Domain counter.
EGameDamageType.ProjectionSorceryBlow: Projection freeze ending in a launch.
EGameDamageType.TagComboBlow: Tag-combo reaction ending in a launch.
EGameDamageType.TagComboCentipedeRestraint: Tag variant of the centipede restraint.
EGameDamageType.TagComboProjectionSorcery: Tag variant of the projection freeze.
EGameDamageType.TagComboProjectionSorceryBlow: Tag projection freeze ending in a launch.

EGameDamageKind.Melee: Direct strike (fist, weapon, body). Standard hit interactions.
EGameDamageKind.Projectile: Detached travelling hit (via Effect rows). Has life, range and pierce rules.
EGameDamageKind.Throwing: Grab-like / thrown interaction. Beats guards that stop strikes.

EGameDamageDirectionType.None: No directional launch. Victim reacts in place.
EGameDamageDirectionType.AttackerDirection: Launch relative to where the attacker faces.
EGameDamageDirectionType.ReceiverDirection: Launch relative to where the victim faces (back-turned hits fly oddly on purpose).
EGameDamageDirectionType.AttackerToReceiver: Launch along the line from attacker to victim. The reliable default for straight hits.
EGameDamageDirectionType.ActorDirection: Launch relative to the spawned actor (effect) facing.
EGameDamageDirectionType.ActorToReceiver: Launch along the line from the effect actor to the victim. For placed traps/zones.
EGameDamageDirectionType.MovementDirection: Launch along the victim's own motion. Extends runners instead of stopping them.

EGameDamageAdaptType.None: Never feeds adaptation. The safe default for most hits.
EGameDamageAdaptType.CursedEnergyAttack_1: Feeds the skill-1 adaptation bucket (Mahoraga-style resistance grows).

EGameAttackTransitionType.None: No cancel. The move always plays out.
EGameAttackTransitionType.InputHit: Cancel on any hit connect with an extra input. The core combo-link rule.
EGameAttackTransitionType.InputHitWithoutGuard: Cancel on hit, but not when guarded. Blocked strings end here.
EGameAttackTransitionType.InputHitWithoutJustGuard: Cancel on hit or normal guard, but a Just Guard shuts the door (rewards parries).
EGameAttackTransitionType.Input: Cancel with input regardless of contact (whiff-cancelable). Makes strings very slippery.
EGameAttackTransitionType.InputTiming: Cancel only with well-timed input. The execution-test gate.
EGameAttackTransitionType.AutoHit: Auto-continues on hit with no extra input (mash-friendly).
EGameAttackTransitionType.AutoHitWithoutGuard: Auto-continues on hit; blocked hits stop the auto string.
EGameAttackTransitionType.OnGround: Continues only while grounded. Air contact breaks the route.

EGameAttackTransitionKind.None: Empty combo slot (padding in the 9-entry array).
